plan.problem: First refinement has the same selected index set but different HashSet traversal orders, changing which seeded random sample is assigned to each parent.
plan.change: Sort selected refinement indices before gathering parent attributes, generating child offsets and scattering updates. Keep original epsilon for all parameter groups.
plan.acceptance: Same index set must yield the same ordered parent-to-offset assignment; preserve membership and opt-out behavior. Validate every actual refinement order, model outputs and aligned quality. No full-training determinism claim.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Adapter training/evaluation/export with the same instrumented local binary; excludes source compilation, SfM and input copy. OS/driver caches not flushed. Image trace is enabled equally in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen historical shared-camera scenes; every eighth image held out from training but used in SfM. Compare RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM at long edge 512. Two repeats are exploratory.

refinement_analysis.scope: Indices address the current Gaussian tensor at each refinement call, not persistent COLMAP point IDs. Ordered assignment is only comparable when the selected set and random offset sequence are the same.

observation_scope: Both variants export normalized PLY snapshots at steps 0/1/10/100 and trace image/sampling/refinement order. First-gradient readbacks are disabled equally. Snapshot readbacks synchronize the GPU and can change execution scheduling; compare only within this round.

validation.parent_sample_assignment_test: passed: stable parent-to-sample assignment for different traversal orders, membership, opt-out order, empty and singleton input

browser.observations: Fine pipes, cables and edges remain blurred; office still shows stretched floating fragments and missing coverage during roaming.

decision: Keep the optional canonical refinement ordering for controlled experiments. No official engine replacement: quality improves on pipes but not office, selected index sets and final models still vary.
